body.label: Target
body.html: Up to two detected enemies within 5 units and 2 units of each other.

body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, each is Distracted and suffers -1 Composure until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Each hit target also has -1 on its next ranged Success Die until the start of your next turn.
Deal 1 Psychic Damage to one hit target.

rider.title: Strain - Fracture
rider.html: If you accepted Strain, choose one hit target: when it next changes targets between Actions before your next turn, you may move 1 unit and learn its remaining Reaction Dice.
